## Definition of Done

- [ ] Coded — implements the user story
- [ ] Working — checked in the browser (light/dark and phone width)
- [ ] Tested — acceptance criteria checked, tests pass
- [ ] Free from major errors — `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass
- [ ] Documented — README / `docs/` updated if usage or setup changed
